composers_checked.name: Corelli, Arcangelo
composers_checked.note: Gap check against the Marx catalogue as used by Brilliant's Complete Edition and MusicBrainz: all 48 trio sonatas Op. 1–4 kept (Op. 1 Nos. 9–12 and Op. 3 Nos. 6, 9, 11, 12 from the opus pages), plus WoO 2, 4 and 5–10. Out: Op. 5 (duos, violin catalogue), Op. 6 and WoO 1 (orchestra). WoO 3 (Sonata a quattro): no recording found. Doubtful Anh. works: the Assisi sonatas Anh. 38–49 are violin sonatas; Anh. 16–31 sonate a tre unrecorded. Minutes = median of four complete cycles (Avison, London Baroque or Aurora, Purcell Quartet, Musica Amphion).

composers_checked.name: Locatelli, Pietro
composers_checked.note: Gap check against Wikipedia's works list (after Dunning): in scope only Op. 5 (one cross-listed set entry, violin id 490) and the four trio sonatas Op. 8 Nos. 7–10. Op. 1, 3, 4 and 7 and the Sinfonia funebre are orchestral, Op. 2 and 6 and Op. 8 Nos. 1–6 are duos, Op. 9 is lost.

composers_checked.name: Sammartini, Giuseppe
composers_checked.note: Kept the 1727 set (complete recording by Fiori Musicali). Op. 3 has no recording found. Wikipedia counts '30 trios for flutes or violins'; the six beyond IMSLP's 24 were not identified. Trios for two flutes or recorders and continuo alone (Op. 1 No. 4 in G, Camerata Köln's trios) have no string part. No Grove list was reachable, hence partial.

note: (1) Locatelli Op. 5 is one set entry because the violin catalogue lists it as one work (id 490, title and level 5 copied); the one-entry-per-work rule would want six entries, which the cross-listing rule does not allow. The owner may want the violin entry split. (2) IMSLP's page 'Trio Sonata in C major, Op.3 No.8 (Corelli)' says E minor in its work info; every recording has C major. Op. 3 No. 12 is A major (IMSLP's Op. 3 page lists A minor). (3) Floor evidence is the Apple Music catalogue (iTunes Search/Lookup API: album, artist, (P) line, timings) and MusicBrainz; catalogue numbers are mostly missing. (4) Corelli levels: all trio sonatas at 2 like the benchmark Op. 1 No. 1; not graded sonata by sonata from the scores. WoO 4 (trumpet) at 4. (5) Corelli WoO 7 has no year on IMSLP; it is one of WoO 5–10 (the others printed 1714), year left blank. (6) Sammartini's 1727 set is printed 'for two German flutes or violins': entered as two violins and continuo with flute as the alternative so that it has its string part; No. 6's key is disputed (D major on the recording, D minor in IMSLP's list), so the title has no key. (7) Not resolved: a 'Sonata in D major for transverse flute, 2 violins and b.c.' on Camerata Köln's 'Sammartini: Concertos' (BMG/DHM 1994) mixes Giuseppe and G. B. Sammartini; the composer of that sonata was not confirmed, so it is not added. BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 1 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Sammartini: Trio Sonata No. 6.
